title: Glowing cliff golem and Watch Sergeant Grolj
summary: Granika reveals a glowing cliff golem guarded by undead watchmen and Watch Sergeant Grolj.
overview: Granika reveals a glowing cliff golem guarded by undead watchmen and Watch Sergeant Grolj.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Complete Granika’s Greenmist quest hand-in only after preparing the group.
The reveal creates the glowing golem, four undead watchmen and Grolj together at the outpost.
Control the watchmen while the group defeats the principal targets and recovers the required quest objective.
